runtime.reader: validated csv module reader; original nested weights, no logL reweighting

prior_semantics: source speed uniform[0,12], isotropic direction; Cartesian density proportional1/|v|^2; nuisance priors inherited
scope: weighted posterior pushforward only; no new fit, posterior-as-likelihood, cross-survey joint significance or independent-survey assumption

csv.normalization: original nonnegative nested weights / their sum (stable scaling)

posterior_pushforward.frame: ICRS Cartesian; sourceward directions transformed from Galactic using astropy SkyCoord
posterior_pushforward.units: km/s; covariance (km/s)^2; ratios dimensionless; temp_beta per degree C
posterior_pushforward.probability_semantics: source-conditional posterior probability, NOT a frequentist p-value
posterior_pushforward.ess_semantics: descriptive weight concentration, not independent sample size
posterior_pushforward.quantile_convention: inverse weighted empirical CDF; central equal-tail68 and95 percent
posterior_pushforward.covariance_convention: normalized posterior population covariance, no Bessel correction
